submissions_closed_note: Owner decision 2026-10-21: no more API submissions; the 585 retries and 514 unsolved questions stay as they are. run.py submit/loop refuse to send while this is true (dry runs still work).

subscription.note: run_sub.py: the same solver (prompts, model, effort, max_tokens, checks) on the Claude subscription through Claude Code in print mode, one fresh process per question. Scope: the math sources below, in priority order (retries first), for every question whose own solution is missing or a Gemini one and that has no generated solution yet. submissions_closed does not apply: it is the API lock.
subscription.hard_note: Owner decision 2026-11-04 (after the trip-up research): the 'hard' sources (olympiad/research, undergraduate competitions, famous-but-tricky puzzles) run at high effort with a 128k output cap, and every question in them is redone, including the ones the API solved at medium. Proof-heavy graduate/exam sources (Kaczor & Nowak, Berkeley, Cambridge Tripos, Stirzaker & Grimmett, Mladenovic, Oksendal) were considered and left at medium.

Each is redone once at its source's effort; a question counts as done once a subscription reply exists for it.

prices_note: USD per million tokens, standard tier, from the Claude API reference cached 2026-10-06; verify against the pricing page. Batch requests are billed at batch_discount times these. cache_write is the 1-hour TTL rate (2x input).
